_comment: Historical scalar baseline for the legacy CLI check/update commands. The nightly workflow checks the source PR Ready and combined-tree PR Ready cohorts from the Shipping SLO snapshot against docs/metrics/shipping-slo-baseline.json.

slo.description: p95 wall-clock ceiling for the PR merge-gate fast-gate tier (ci-fast + unit-tests). Measured from workflow run created_at to last fast-gate job completed_at. Ceiling = p95GateSeconds × 1.2 = 755s (~12.6 min).
